title: 第二卷8 极夜危机雪原白虹第二卷九冰心初融
content_zh:
;;
挪威，斯瓦尔巴群岛，朗伊尔城。
世界最北端的城镇，此时正陷入长达四个月的极夜。下午三点，天已黑透。街灯在风雪中晕出昏黄的光圈，寥寥几个行人裹着厚重的防寒服匆匆走过，呼出的白气瞬间凝结成冰晶。
杨思纯六人住在一家不起眼的小旅馆里。窗外是连绵的雪山剪影，北极光在天际缓缓流淌，绿紫色的光带如神灵的裙摆，美得不真实。
“根据情报，暗影议会的‘北极星基地’在东北方向七十公里处的冰盖下。”江流云在桌上摊开卫星地图，“地表没有任何建筑痕迹，入口应该隐藏在冰川裂缝中。”
柳如是趴在窗边看极光，忽然说：“那里的水……在害怕。”
作为拥有仙灵之力的人她能感知全球水脉的情绪。此刻，东北方向的冰川深处，传来细微的颤抖——那是冰层下的暗流在恐惧某种存在。
惜若正在擦拭秋水剑，闻言抬头：“卡尔文说过，他们志在必得。基地里肯定有对付异能者的手段。”
“所以我们需要基地老刘提供的这个。”江流云打开行李箱，里面是六套特制的装备。
纯黑色的紧身作战服，表面有细密的银色纹路；战术背心上挂满各种模块；头盔是流线型半覆面设计，眼部位置是透明的护目镜，但镜片内显示着复杂的数据流。
“纳米凯夫拉普拉特纤维作战服，能抵抗零下五十度低温，内嵌温度调节系统。”江流云拿起一件，“银色纹路是‘异能抑制抵消回路’，可以部分对抗异能抑制场。”
“部分？”永珍问道。
“如果抑制场太强，只能减弱，不能完全抵消。”江流云坦白，“所以，我们还准备了b计划。”
他又取出几个巴掌大小的金属圆盘：“‘时空锚点信标’。万一异能完全失效，捏碎它，可以瞬间传送回这里——但只能用一次，而且有三十秒启动延迟。”
杨思纯拿起作战服，手感轻盈却坚韧：“什么时候出发？”
“午夜。”江流云看向窗外，“极夜虽然黑暗，但基地的巡逻可能会放松。而且……”
他顿了顿：“气象预报显示，凌晨一点有暴风雪。正好掩护。”
---
夜里十一点，众人换上装备。
作战服贴身勾勒出身体线条，科技感十足。惜若的白衣终于换下，此刻一身黑衣，反而衬得眉心透明小鲤印记更加娇俏，柳如是笨拙地扣着战术背心的卡扣，还是江流云帮她整理妥当。

“这个按钮是通讯，这个是夜视模式，这个是……”江流云耐心讲解。
柳如是认真听着，忽然问：“江大哥，如果我的仙灵之力又失灵了，这个衣服能保护我吗？”
“能护住一些。”江流云帮她调整头盔，“但最好的保护，是跟紧我们。”
沈轻烟检查着每个人的装备，最后走到杨思纯面前，替他整了整衣领：“小心。”
“你也是。”
没有更多话语，一个眼神已足够。
午夜十二点，六道身影悄无声息地离开旅馆，融入极夜的风雪中。
为保存体力他们租用了改装过的雪地摩托，摩托在冰川上飞驰。车灯只开最低亮度，在能见度不足十米的暴风雪中，如同萤火。永珍操控着导航仪——这是刘建国提供的军用级设备，即使在强烈电磁干扰下也能工作。
一小多小时后，抵达目标区域。
眼前是一片巨大的冰原，狂风卷起雪沫，能见度几乎为零。但在夜视仪中，冰原深处，有一个不起眼的裂缝，裂缝边缘有微弱的热源信号——那是通风口。
“入口应该就在下面。”江流云压低声音，“我先下去探路。”
他顺着绳索滑入裂缝。几分钟后，通讯器传来声音：“安全，下来吧。”
众人依次下降。裂缝比想象中深，下降了约五十米才到底部。这里是一个天然冰洞，但洞壁上有人工开凿的痕迹，还有隐藏的摄像头和激光感应器。
“跟着我的脚步，别踩错。”江流云在前面带路，他开启了隐流之术结阵，身形几乎与黑暗融为一体，只有战术目镜上的数据流显示着他们的位置。
避开三道防线后，前方出现一扇厚重的合金门。门上没有锁孔，只有一个手掌识别屏。
“需要权限。”沈轻烟皱眉。
惜若上前，手指轻触识别屏边缘。金灵之力渗透，试图破解电路。但就在她灵力接触的瞬间，门上方突然亮起红灯！
刺耳的警报响彻冰洞！
“异能探测！他们设置了异能感应器！”江流云急道。
合金门轰然打开，不是让他们进去，而是从门内涌出二十几名武装人员！这些人穿着白色雪地作战服，手持的武器不是常规枪械，而是发射蓝色光束的能量枪！他们行动迅捷，三人一组，呈战术队形展开，显然训练有素。

更可怕的是，他们出现的同时，整个冰洞内弥漫开一种诡异的力场。杨思纯感觉体内的水系灵力瞬间滞涩，如同陷入泥潭；惜若的金灵之力也大幅衰减；柳如是的仙灵之力直接“罢工”了。
“异能抑制场……比预想的强太多！”永珍咬牙，冰灵之力只能凝聚出薄薄一层冰盾。
蓝色光束如暴雨般射来！冰盾瞬间碎裂！众人急忙闪避，但洞内空间狭窄，很快被压制到角落。

Norway, Svalbard, Longyearbyen.
The world's northernmost town is currently plunged into a four-month-long polar night. At three o'clock in the afternoon, it was already dark. The street lights cast a dim halo in the wind and snow, and a few pedestrians hurried past wrapped in heavy cold-proof clothing. The white air they exhaled instantly condensed into ice crystals.
Yang Sichun and six others lived in an inconspicuous small hotel. Outside the window is the silhouette of the continuous snow-capped mountains. The Northern Lights are slowly flowing in the sky. The green and purple light strips are like the skirt of the gods. It is so beautiful that it is unreal.
"According to intelligence, the Shadow Council's 'Polaris Base' is under the ice cap seventy kilometers northeast." Jiang Liuyun spread out the satellite map on the table. "There are no traces of buildings on the surface. The entrance should be hidden in the glacier crevices."
Liu Rushi was lying by the window watching the aurora, and suddenly said: "The water there... is scary."
As a person with fairy powers she can sense the emotions of water veins around the world. At this moment, a slight tremor came from the depths of the glacier in the northeast - it was the undercurrent under the ice that was fearing some kind of existence.
Xiruo was wiping the Qiu Shui Sword and raised her head when she heard this: "Calvin said that they are determined to win. There must be ways to deal with superpowers in the base."
"So we need this provided by Base Liu." Jiang Liuyun opened the suitcase, which contained six sets of special equipment.
The pure black tight-fitting combat uniform has fine silver lines on the surface; the tactical vest is covered with various modules; the helmet has a streamlined half-cover design, and there are transparent goggles on the eyes, but complex data streams are displayed inside the lenses.
"The nano-Kevlar Plat fiber combat uniform can withstand temperatures as low as -50 degrees Celsius and has a built-in temperature regulation system." Jiang Liuyun picked up one. "The silver pattern is the 'power suppression cancellation circuit', which can partially resist the power suppression field."
"Partially?" Yongzhen asked.
"If the suppression field is too strong, it can only be weakened but cannot be completely offset." Jiang Liuyun confessed, "So, we have also prepared plan B."
He took out several more palm-sized metal discs: "'Space-time Anchor Beacon'. If the power fails completely, crush it and you can teleport back here instantly - but it can only be used once, and there is a thirty-second activation delay."
Yang Sichun picked up the combat uniform, which felt light but tough: "When will we set off?"
"Midnight." Jiang Liuyun looked out the window, "Although the polar night is dark, the patrols at the base may be relaxed. And..."
He paused: "The weather forecast shows that there will be a snowstorm at one o'clock in the morning. Just cover."
---
At eleven o'clock at night, everyone changed into equipment.
The combat uniform outlines the body lines closely and is full of technology. Xiruo finally changed out of her white clothes and was now dressed in black, which made the transparent little carp mark between her eyebrows look even more delicate. Liu Ru was clumsily buttoning the tactical vest, but Jiang Liuyun helped her arrange it properly.
"This button is communication, this is night vision mode, this is..." Jiang Liuyun explained patiently.
Liu Rushi listened carefully and suddenly asked: "Brother Jiang, if my fairy power fails again, can this clothes protect me?"
"It can provide some protection." Jiang Liuyun helped her adjust the helmet, "But the best protection is to follow us closely."
Shen Qingyan checked everyone's equipment, and finally walked up to Yang Sichun and straightened his collar: "Be careful."
"You too."
No more words, just one look is enough.
At twelve o'clock at midnight, six figures quietly left the hotel and blended into the snow and wind of the polar night.
In order to save their energy, they rented a modified snowmobile and drove it on the glacier. The car lights were only turned on at their lowest brightness, like fireflies in the snowstorm with visibility less than ten meters. Yongzhen controls the navigator, a military-grade device provided by Liu Jianguo that can work even under strong electromagnetic interference.
After more than an hour, we arrived at the target area.
In front of you is a huge ice field, with strong winds blowing up snow foam, visibility is almost zero. But in the night vision device, deep in the ice sheet, there is an inconspicuous crack, with a weak heat source signal on the edge of the crack - that is the vent.
"The entrance should be down there." Jiang Liuyun lowered his voice, "I'll go down first to explore the way."
He slid along the rope into the crevice. A few minutes later, a voice came from the communicator: "It's safe, come down."
Everyone descended one after another. The crack was deeper than expected, and it dropped about fifty meters to the bottom. This is a natural ice cave, but there are traces of artificial excavation on the cave wall, as well as hidden cameras and laser sensors.
"Follow my footsteps and don't make mistakes." Jiang Liuyun led the way. He activated the Hidden Current Technique to form a formation. His figure almost blended into the darkness. Only the data stream on the tactical eyepiece showed their position.
After avoiding the three lines of defense, a thick alloy door appeared in front. There is no keyhole on the door, just a palm recognition screen.
"Permission is required." Shen Qingyan frowned.
Xiruo stepped forward and touched the edge of the recognition screen with her finger. The power of the golden spirit penetrated and tried to crack the circuit. But the moment her spiritual power came into contact, a red light suddenly lit up above the door!
The piercing alarm rang through the ice cave!
"Superpower detection! They have set up superpower sensors!" Jiang Liuyun said anxiously.
The alloy door opened with a bang, and instead of letting them in, more than twenty armed men poured out from the door! These people were wearing white snow combat uniforms, and the weapons they held were not conventional firearms, but energy guns that fired blue beams! They moved quickly, spread out in tactical formations in groups of three, and were obviously well-trained.
What's even more terrifying is that at the same time they appeared, a strange force field filled the entire ice cave. Yang Sichun felt that the water spiritual power in his body was instantly stagnant, as if he was stuck in a quagmire; Xiruo's golden spirit power also weakened significantly; Liu Rushi's fairy power directly "strike".
"The superpower suppression field... is much stronger than expected!" Yongzhen gritted his teeth, and the power of the ice spirit could only condense a thin layer of ice shield.
Blue beams of light came like a torrential rain! The ice shield shattered instantly! Everyone hurriedly dodged, but the space in the cave was narrow and they were quickly suppressed to the corner.
